decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits at the core of the firm's offer and had its own page in both observed years, so keeping this option open costs little and it has likely already proven its value.

Shuttering magnets are a standard consumable in precast plants and close to the established offer, so the low carrying cost and steady demand justify keeping the option even though the website only mentions it.
The magnetic formwork component kept a dedicated page through 2019, which signals continued commitment, and it costs little to maintain within the existing formwork portfolio.

This component is only mentioned and overlaps with similar magnetic items, one of which was already removed, so consolidation is possible, but the cheap upkeep and remaining uncertainty favor keeping it for now.
